description: This file defines classes and methods for querying, fetching, and processing yield curve data from EconDB, including parameter validation, data transformation, and asynchronous data retrieval.

classes.name: EconDbYieldCurveQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for EconDB yield curve data, including country and cache options, with validation.

classes.name: EconDbYieldCurveData
classes.description: Represents individual yield curve data entries from EconDB.

classes.name: EconDbYieldCurveFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming yield curve data asynchronously from EconDB API.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into an EconDbYieldCurveQueryParams instance, setting current date if missing.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches yield curve data for specified countries, handling caching, API requests, and error/warning reporting.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into structured yield curve data objects, aligning dates, maturities, and formatting for output.
